catalogue.name: kuber_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts with ids, names, natures and current balances.

catalogue.name: kuber_chart_of_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts as a tree: id, name, category (asset, liability, equity, income, expense), the statement it maps to (balance sheet or P&L) and its reporting tag, control and cash flags, whether

catalogue.name: kuber_trial_balance
catalogue.description: Trial balance as of a date (default today): every account with a balance, debit or credit, and the totals, which must agree.

catalogue.name: kuber_profit_and_loss
catalogue.description: Income, expenses and surplus for a period (default: the book's fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date (default today), with the surplus to date; the check line must be zero.

catalogue.name: kuber_ledger
catalogue.description: One account's statement for a period: opening balance, every line (date, narration, debit, credit), totals and closing balance.

catalogue.name: kuber_search_journals
catalogue.description: Find journals by narration text, account, date range and amount range (rupees; the journal's total debits), newest first, paged.

catalogue.name: kuber_review_queue
catalogue.description: Drafts waiting for a person: what the classifier proposed (account, confidence) and why each is not posted yet.

catalogue.name: kuber_match_reviews
catalogue.description: Statement lines that may be a provisional entry already in the books, waiting for a person to link or separate them.

catalogue.name: kuber_income_breakdown
catalogue.description: Sales, revenue and other income by account and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_expense_breakdown
catalogue.description: Spending by category (account) and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year), largest first with each category's share.

catalogue.name: kuber_cash_position
catalogue.description: Cash and bank balances by account, average monthly spend over the last three months and runway in months at that rate.

catalogue.name: kuber_parties
catalogue.description: Vendors and customers of this workspace: name, kind, legal entity, payment hold (an unverified bank-detail change) and bank details masked to the last four digits.

catalogue.name: kuber_policies
catalogue.description: Search the policy library (policies/*.md) by id (e.g.

catalogue.name: kuber_lifecycle
catalogue.description: Every entry's lifecycle state (draft, submitted, approved, posting, posted, failed) across drafts, plans, ledger rejections and schedule exceptions, with counts and failure reasons.

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.name: kuber_group_structure

catalogue.name: kuber_group_pnl
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated profit and loss for the fiscal year to the period end, with profit attributable to non-controlling interest and to the owners of the parent.

catalogue.name: kuber_nci
catalogue.description: Non-controlling interest per subsidiary at a period end: the NCI %, the subsidiary's net assets and profit, and NCI's share of each, at the ownership in force.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_perimeter
catalogue.description: Who is in the group on a date: each entity's method (full, equity, excluded with the reason), ownership and effective interest, NCI and the source of its pack.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel

catalogue.name: kuber_chart_of_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts as a tree: id, name, category (asset, liability, equity, income, expense), the statement it maps to (balance sheet or P&L) and its reporting tag, control and cash flags, whether

catalogue.name: kuber_trial_balance
catalogue.description: Trial balance as of a date (default today): every account with a balance, debit or credit, and the totals, which must agree.

catalogue.name: kuber_profit_and_loss
catalogue.description: Income, expenses and surplus for a period (default: the book's fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date (default today), with the surplus to date; the check line must be zero.

catalogue.name: kuber_ledger
catalogue.description: One account's statement for a period: opening balance, every line (date, narration, debit, credit), totals and closing balance.

catalogue.name: kuber_search_journals
catalogue.description: Find journals by narration text, account, date range and amount range (rupees; the journal's total debits), newest first, paged.

catalogue.name: kuber_review_queue
catalogue.description: Drafts waiting for a person: what the classifier proposed (account, confidence) and why each is not posted yet.

catalogue.name: kuber_match_reviews
catalogue.description: Statement lines that may be a provisional entry already in the books, waiting for a person to link or separate them.

catalogue.name: kuber_income_breakdown
catalogue.description: Sales, revenue and other income by account and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_expense_breakdown
catalogue.description: Spending by category (account) and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year), largest first with each category's share.

catalogue.name: kuber_cash_position
catalogue.description: Cash and bank balances by account, average monthly spend over the last three months and runway in months at that rate.

catalogue.name: kuber_parties
catalogue.description: Vendors and customers of this workspace: name, kind, legal entity, payment hold (an unverified bank-detail change) and bank details masked to the last four digits.

catalogue.name: kuber_policies
catalogue.description: Search the policy library (policies/*.md) by id (e.g.

catalogue.name: kuber_lifecycle
catalogue.description: Every entry's lifecycle state (draft, submitted, approved, posting, posted, failed) across drafts, plans, ledger rejections and schedule exceptions, with counts and failure reasons.

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.description: The group's consolidated profit and loss for the fiscal year to the period end, with profit attributable to non-controlling interest and to the owners of the parent.

catalogue.name: kuber_nci
catalogue.description: Non-controlling interest per subsidiary at a period end: the NCI %, the subsidiary's net assets and profit, and NCI's share of each, at the ownership in force.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_perimeter
catalogue.description: Who is in the group on a date: each entity's method (full, equity, excluded with the reason), ownership and effective interest, NCI and the source of its pack.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel

catalogue.name: kuber_chart_of_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts as a tree: id, name, category (asset, liability, equity, income, expense), the statement it maps to (balance sheet or P&L) and its reporting tag, control and cash flags, whether

catalogue.name: kuber_trial_balance
catalogue.description: Trial balance as of a date (default today): every account with a balance, debit or credit, and the totals, which must agree.

catalogue.name: kuber_profit_and_loss
catalogue.description: Income, expenses and surplus for a period (default: the book's fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date (default today), with the surplus to date; the check line must be zero.

catalogue.name: kuber_ledger
catalogue.description: One account's statement for a period: opening balance, every line (date, narration, debit, credit), totals and closing balance.

catalogue.name: kuber_search_journals
catalogue.description: Find journals by narration text, account, date range and amount range (rupees; the journal's total debits), newest first, paged.

catalogue.name: kuber_review_queue
catalogue.description: Drafts waiting for a person: what the classifier proposed (account, confidence) and why each is not posted yet.

catalogue.name: kuber_match_reviews
catalogue.description: Statement lines that may be a provisional entry already in the books, waiting for a person to link or separate them.

catalogue.name: kuber_income_breakdown
catalogue.description: Sales, revenue and other income by account and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_expense_breakdown
catalogue.description: Spending by category (account) and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year), largest first with each category's share.

catalogue.name: kuber_cash_position
catalogue.description: Cash and bank balances by account, average monthly spend over the last three months and runway in months at that rate.

catalogue.name: kuber_parties
catalogue.description: Vendors and customers of this workspace: name, kind, legal entity, payment hold (an unverified bank-detail change) and bank details masked to the last four digits.

catalogue.name: kuber_policies
catalogue.description: Search the policy library (policies/*.md) by id (e.g.

catalogue.name: kuber_lifecycle
catalogue.description: Every entry's lifecycle state (draft, submitted, approved, posting, posted, failed) across drafts, plans, ledger rejections and schedule exceptions, with counts and failure reasons.

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.name: kuber_group_structure
catalogue.description: Set the group's entities (each with its book in this workspace, or its linked tenant, and its functional currency) and/or map entity accounts to group accounts (overriding their statement mapping).

catalogue.name: kuber_group_ownership
catalogue.description: Record, effective from a date, who owns an entity of the group: ownership %, voting %, the control assessment and the method (full, equity or excluded with its reason), with the acquisition facts used

catalogue.name: kuber_group_ic_link
catalogue.description: Declare that a party in one entity's party master IS another entity of the group, so journals on control accounts with that party are tagged intercompany.

catalogue.description: Certify the group's statements for a period end.

catalogue.description: After both sides resolved an intercompany dispute at an agreed amount, bring THIS book's side to that amount: the difference between what this entity recorded and the agreed amount, against the accoun

catalogue.name: kuber_group_trial_balance
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated trial balance at a period end: each group account's total from the entities' packs, the eliminations in the consolidation book, and the consolidated balance (debit positive).

catalogue.name: kuber_group_pnl
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated profit and loss for the fiscal year to the period end, with profit attributable to non-controlling interest and to the owners of the parent.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated balance sheet at a period end, with non-controlling interest shown separately from the owners' equity.

catalogue.description: Intercompany documents matched by counterparty, document (IC reference), currency and period: matched, in transit (sent, not received, with the difference explained), mismatched (period, FX, tax or am

catalogue.name: kuber_nci
catalogue.description: Non-controlling interest per subsidiary at a period end: the NCI %, the subsidiary's net assets and profit, and NCI's share of each, at the ownership in force.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_perimeter
catalogue.description: Who is in the group on a date: each entity's method (full, equity, excluded with the reason), ownership and effective interest, NCI and the source of its pack.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts with ids, names, natures and current balances.

catalogue.name: kuber_chart_of_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts as a tree: id, name, category (asset, liability, equity, income, expense), the statement it maps to (balance sheet or P&L) and its reporting tag, control and cash flags, whether

catalogue.name: kuber_trial_balance
catalogue.description: Trial balance as of a date (default today): every account with a balance, debit or credit, and the totals, which must agree.

catalogue.name: kuber_profit_and_loss
catalogue.description: Income, expenses and surplus for a period (default: the book's fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date (default today), with the surplus to date; the check line must be zero.

catalogue.name: kuber_ledger
catalogue.description: One account's statement for a period: opening balance, every line (date, narration, debit, credit), totals and closing balance.

catalogue.name: kuber_search_journals
catalogue.description: Find journals by narration text, account, date range and amount range (rupees; the journal's total debits), newest first, paged.

catalogue.name: kuber_review_queue
catalogue.description: Drafts waiting for a person: what the classifier proposed (account, confidence) and why each is not posted yet.

catalogue.name: kuber_match_reviews
catalogue.description: Statement lines that may be a provisional entry already in the books, waiting for a person to link or separate them.

catalogue.name: kuber_income_breakdown
catalogue.description: Sales, revenue and other income by account and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_expense_breakdown
catalogue.description: Spending by category (account) and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year), largest first with each category's share.

catalogue.name: kuber_cash_position
catalogue.description: Cash and bank balances by account, average monthly spend over the last three months and runway in months at that rate.

catalogue.name: kuber_parties
catalogue.description: Vendors and customers of this workspace: name, kind, legal entity, payment hold (an unverified bank-detail change) and bank details masked to the last four digits.

catalogue.name: kuber_policies
catalogue.description: Search the policy library (policies/*.md) by id (e.g.

catalogue.name: kuber_lifecycle
catalogue.description: Every entry's lifecycle state (draft, submitted, approved, posting, posted, failed) across drafts, plans, ledger rejections and schedule exceptions, with counts and failure reasons.

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.name: kuber_group_structure
catalogue.description: Set the group's entities (each with its book in this workspace, or its linked tenant, and its functional currency) and/or map entity accounts to group accounts (overriding their statement mapping).

catalogue.name: kuber_group_ownership
catalogue.description: Record, effective from a date, who owns an entity of the group: ownership %, voting %, the control assessment and the method (full, equity or excluded with its reason), with the acquisition facts used

catalogue.name: kuber_group_ic_link
catalogue.description: Declare that a party in one entity's party master IS another entity of the group, so journals on control accounts with that party are tagged intercompany.

catalogue.name: kuber_consolidate
catalogue.description: Compute the group's eliminations for a period end: intercompany balances and income/expense (matched amounts only; differences stay open, never plugged), investment against equity at acquisition (good

catalogue.name: kuber_certify_group
catalogue.description: Certify the group's statements for a period end.

catalogue.name: kuber_ic_adjust
catalogue.description: After both sides resolved an intercompany dispute at an agreed amount, bring THIS book's side to that amount: the difference between what this entity recorded and the agreed amount, against the accoun

catalogue.name: kuber_group_trial_balance
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated trial balance at a period end: each group account's total from the entities' packs, the eliminations in the consolidation book, and the consolidated balance (debit positive).

catalogue.name: kuber_group_pnl
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated profit and loss for the fiscal year to the period end, with profit attributable to non-controlling interest and to the owners of the parent.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: The group's consolidated balance sheet at a period end, with non-controlling interest shown separately from the owners' equity.

catalogue.name: kuber_ic_mismatches
catalogue.description: Intercompany documents matched by counterparty, document (IC reference), currency and period: matched, in transit (sent, not received, with the difference explained), mismatched (period, FX, tax or am

catalogue.name: kuber_nci
catalogue.description: Non-controlling interest per subsidiary at a period end: the NCI %, the subsidiary's net assets and profit, and NCI's share of each, at the ownership in force.

catalogue.name: kuber_group_perimeter
catalogue.description: Who is in the group on a date: each entity's method (full, equity, excluded with the reason), ownership and effective interest, NCI and the source of its pack.

catalogue.name: kuber_plans
catalogue.description: Plans proposed but not yet committed or discarded, newest first.

catalogue.name: kuber_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts with ids, names, natures and current balances.

catalogue.name: kuber_chart_of_accounts
catalogue.description: The chart of accounts as a tree: id, name, category (asset, liability, equity, income, expense), the statement it maps to (balance sheet or P&L) and its reporting tag, control and cash flags, whether

catalogue.name: kuber_trial_balance
catalogue.description: Trial balance as of a date (default today): every account with a balance, debit or credit, and the totals, which must agree.

catalogue.name: kuber_profit_and_loss
catalogue.description: Income, expenses and surplus for a period (default: the book's fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance_sheet
catalogue.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date (default today), with the surplus to date; the check line must be zero.

catalogue.name: kuber_ledger
catalogue.description: One account's statement for a period: opening balance, every line (date, narration, debit, credit), totals and closing balance.

catalogue.name: kuber_search_journals
catalogue.description: Find journals by narration text, account, date range and amount range (rupees; the journal's total debits), newest first, paged.

catalogue.name: kuber_review_queue
catalogue.description: Drafts waiting for a person: what the classifier proposed (account, confidence) and why each is not posted yet.

catalogue.name: kuber_match_reviews
catalogue.description: Statement lines that may be a provisional entry already in the books, waiting for a person to link or separate them.

catalogue.name: kuber_income_breakdown
catalogue.description: Sales, revenue and other income by account and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year).

catalogue.name: kuber_expense_breakdown
catalogue.description: Spending by category (account) and by month for a period (default: the fiscal year), largest first with each category's share.

catalogue.name: kuber_cash_position
catalogue.description: Cash and bank balances by account, average monthly spend over the last three months and runway in months at that rate.

catalogue.name: kuber_parties
catalogue.description: Vendors and customers of this workspace: name, kind, legal entity, payment hold (an unverified bank-detail change) and bank details masked to the last four digits.

catalogue.name: kuber_lifecycle
catalogue.description: Every entry's lifecycle state (draft, submitted, approved, posting, posted, failed) across drafts, plans, ledger rejections and schedule exceptions, with counts and failure reasons.

catalogue.name: kuber_attention
catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_record
catalogue.description: Record money in or out: one amount, where it belongs, and which money account (bank, cash or card) it moved through.

catalogue.name: kuber_post
catalogue.description: Post entries Kuber drafted from statements, in bulk, as classified (or with per-draft account overrides).

catalogue.name: kuber_balance
catalogue.description: Prove the books are in order: debits equal credits, the hash chain is intact, nothing is stuck in suspense, reports are current, and list what is still open.

catalogue.name: kuber_reconcile
catalogue.description: Reconcile a bank, cash or card account to its statement closing balance: explains the difference by entries not yet in the statement and statement lines not yet in the books, and optionally posts an a

catalogue.name: kuber_allocate
catalogue.description: Split an amount (or an account's movement for a period) across accounts, cost centres or projects by weights.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
catalogue.description: Move money between your asset accounts (bank, cash, investments, deposits) to reach target shares of the pool.

catalogue.name: kuber_close
catalogue.description: Close a month or a financial year.

catalogue.name: kuber_carry_forward
catalogue.description: Open the next financial year from a closed one: verifies the closing voucher emptied income and expenses, and that the new year's opening balance sheet equals the closed year's closing balance sheet,

catalogue.name: kuber_report
catalogue.description: Income and expenses, balance sheet, trial balance or statement of affairs for a period.

catalogue.name: kuber_simulate
catalogue.description: What-if without touching the books: apply hypothetical transactions and recurring monthly changes to the current position and show cash, net worth, surplus and runway before and after.

catalogue.name: kuber_dashboard
catalogue.description: Live position: cash, net worth, this year's surplus, average monthly spend and runway, top spending categories, month-by-month trend and what needs attention.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_approve
catalogue.description: Approve a recurring journal or a prepaid/accrual recognition schedule once.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedule_cancel
catalogue.description: Cancel a recurring or recognition schedule from a date.

catalogue.name: kuber_schedules
catalogue.description: Recurring and recognition schedules with every occurrence's status, open exceptions, remaining balances, and the reconciliation of schedule balances to the GL by period.

catalogue.name: kuber_resolve_suspense
catalogue.description: Clear one suspense item: the original entry is reversed on the resolution date and reposted to the right account, and the item records original, reversal and replacement.

catalogue.name: kuber_suspense
catalogue.description: Every suspense item with its source, owner, age and resolution, and the roll-forward for a period (default: the book's fiscal year to date): opening + additions − resolved = closing, tied to the GL su

catalogue.name: kuber_nci

catalogue.name: kuber_group_perimeter

catalogue.description: What needs a person now: drafts in review and awaiting approval, postings to ratify, open plans, open suspense items and statement lines to match.

catalogue.name: kuber_rebalance
